description: Defines the URLRequestFilter class, which manages URL request interceptors for filtering network requests based on URL or hostname. Implements singleton pattern, provides methods to add/remove interceptors, and tracks usage count.

classes.name: URLRequestFilter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages URL request interceptors for filtering network requests based on URL or hostname.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of URLRequestFilter.

methods.name: AddHostnameInterceptor
methods.description: Adds an interceptor for requests matching a specific scheme and hostname.

methods.name: RemoveHostnameHandler
methods.description: Removes the hostname-based interceptor for a given scheme and hostname.

methods.name: AddUrlInterceptor
methods.description: Adds an interceptor for a specific URL.

methods.name: RemoveUrlHandler
methods.description: Removes the URL-based interceptor for a specific URL.

methods.name: ClearHandlers
methods.description: Clears all URL and hostname interceptors and resets hit count.

methods.name: hit_count
methods.description: Returns the number of times interceptors have been used.

methods.name: MaybeInterceptRequest
methods.description: Attempts to intercept a URL request, returning a URLRequestJob if intercepted.
